notes.title: Update - version 1.02
notes.content:
We hope you are enjoying Aviary Attorney. The main addition of this update is [b]Chapter 4C[/b]! Thanks for all of your patience while we finished putting the final ending together.

Fixed in this update:

- Chapter 4C added.
- Several bugs have been squashed.
- A "delete save data" button has been added to the main options screen. If all of your save data has been corrupted, or if you are unable to get past the first screen of chapter 1, then please try using this button.

Next update:

- Further bug fixes.
- Linux version.

Future updates:

- Bonus chapter 
- Multiple language support

notes.title: Update - version 1.01
notes.content:
We hope you are enjoying Aviary Attorney! We've just released an update to address some of the more pressing issues that have come up since release.

Fixed in this update:

- "Save & Quit" button now saves from the start of whatever room you entered. [Edit: This has been disabled again until we can work out some save file issues]
- The broken link to Chapter 4B (succeeding in the third case) now links correctly.
- Various other game-breaking bugs and location problems

Next update:

- Fix Chapter 4C (failing the third case)
- Spalling and grommer fixes

Near future updates:

- Linux version
- Achievements

Future future updates:

- Bonus chapter
- Multiple language support
